reason: A web GUI for managing DSH and system crontab schedules, executing recurring commands, reviewing logs, and optionally sending completion notifications.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH Web 界面中创建和管理 DSH 及系统定时任务、查看执行记录并配置完成通知。
summaries.en: A DSH Web panel for creating and managing DSH and system cron tasks, reviewing execution logs, and configuring completion notifications.

capabilities: Create, edit, delete, enable, and disable DSH and system cron tasks
Parse natural-language schedules into cron expressions
Execute scheduled commands and display execution logs
Send task completion notifications through a configured message gateway
